style.loanwords_text: Common technical loanwords (e.g. blockchain, wallet, bridge) may remain in Latin script where that is the natural Portuguese usage; do not force awkward coinages.

node.inflection: It is NOT a loanword: use the translated term in compounds and plurals too.

changelog.summary: Imported from the runner's hand-written prompt_head_pt.txt: language variety, loanword rule and the node rendering, approved by the steward as legacy prompt-head rules.
Gate only (not sent to the model): abbreviations written with a full stop, so the sentence-boundary gate stops reading them as sentence ends (e.g. "out. …").
